healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the Float API token by listing accounts.

page.description: Page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Float max is 200.

people.list.title: List People
people.list.description: Find people on the Float schedule by department, email, type, tags, and related account details.

page.description: Page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Float max is 200.

departmentId.description: Department ID to filter people by.

sort.description: Field to sort by. Prefix with - for descending.

modifiedSince.description: Return records modified at or after this YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS value or Unix timestamp.

fields.description: Comma-delimited field names to include in the response.

expand.description: Comma-delimited expand values: account, managers, contracts.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor from X-Pagination-Next-Cursor for the next page.

page.description: Page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Float max is 200.

projects.list.title: List Projects
projects.list.description: Find Float projects by code, client, lifecycle state, billing state, status, or tags.

page.description: Page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Float max is 200.

clientId.description: Return only projects belonging to this client ID.

sort.description: Field to sort by. Prefix with - for descending.

modifiedSince.description: Return records modified at or after this YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS value or Unix timestamp.

fields.description: Comma-delimited field names to include in the response.

expand.description: Comma-delimited expand values: phases, project_tasks, project_team, expenses, currency_code.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor from X-Pagination-Next-Cursor for the next page.

projects.get.title: Get Project
projects.get.description: Retrieve one Float project by ID, optionally expanding phases, project tasks, team, expenses, or currency.

projectId.description: ID of the project to retrieve.

expand.description: Comma-delimited expand values: phases, project_tasks, project_team, expenses, currency_code.

projects.create.title: Create Project
projects.create.description: Create a Float project with core scheduling and classification fields. Rates, currencies, budgets, and project-team replacement are omitted.

clientId.description: ID of the client that owns the project.

color.description: Project color as a hexadecimal value.

tags.description: Tags to assign to the project.

projects.update.title: Update Project
projects.update.description: Update selected core identity, schedule, lifecycle, and tag fields on a Float project.

projectId.description: ID of the project to update.

color.description: New project color as a hexadecimal value.

tags.description: Complete replacement list of project tags.

allocations.list.title: List Allocations
allocations.list.description: Find scheduled allocations (tasks) in Float by project, person, client, phase, project task, date range, billing state, status, or recurrence.

page.description: Page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Float max is 200.

projectId.description: Return allocations for this project ID.

peopleId.description: Return allocations assigned to this person ID.

clientId.description: Return allocations for projects belonging to this client ID.

phaseId.description: Return allocations for this project phase ID.

projectTaskId.description: Return allocations associated with this project task ID (task_meta_id).

repeatState.description: 0=none, 1=weekly, 2=monthly, 3=every two weeks, 4=every three weeks, 5=every six weeks, 6=every two months, 7=every three months, 8=every six months, 9=yearly.

sort.description: Field to sort by. Prefix with - for descending.

modifiedSince.description: Return records modified at or after this YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS value or Unix timestamp.

fields.description: Comma-delimited field names to include in the response.

expand.description: Use task_days to include calculated working dates (requires start_date and end_date).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor from X-Pagination-Next-Cursor for the next page.

allocations.create.title: Create Allocation
allocations.create.description: Schedule work on a Float project for one or more people, or leave it unassigned, with optional phase, status, notes, and recurrence.

projectId.description: ID of the project receiving the allocation.

hours.description: Hours scheduled per working day (official hours field).

peopleId.description: Person ID to assign. Omit together with peopleIds to create an unassigned allocation.

peopleIds.description: One or more person IDs. Ignored when peopleId is set.

phaseId.description: Project phase ID for the allocation.

startTime.description: Optional daily start time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

name.description: Project task name. Float may create the project-task definition when no matching name exists.

projectTaskId.description: Existing project task ID (task_meta_id); takes precedence over name.

repeatState.description: 0=none, 1=weekly, 2=monthly, 3=every two weeks, 4=every three weeks, 5=every six weeks, 6=every two months, 7=every three months, 8=every six months, 9=yearly.

allocations.update.title: Update Allocation
allocations.update.description: Reschedule or revise selected fields of a Float allocation (task_id). Sends only fields explicitly supplied.

taskId.description: Float task_id of the allocation to update.

hours.description: New hours scheduled per working day.

startTime.description: New daily start time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

notes.description: Replacement details about the scheduled work.

name.description: New project task name when projectTaskId is not supplied.

reports.people.get.title: Get People Capacity Report
reports.people.get.description: Return person-level capacity, scheduled, unscheduled, time-off, billable, and non-billable totals for a required date range.

peopleId.description: Return report data only for this person ID.

reports.projects.get.title: Get Project Utilization Report
reports.projects.get.description: Return project-level scheduled, logged, billable, non-billable, budget, and utilization totals for a required date range, optionally for one project.

projectId.description: Return report data only for this project ID.
